Computation aid for slices that are not listed in INDEX.md (not the result of any command).
Bucket H = the files whose end stamp is in (H:00, H+1:00], i.e. the records of hour H (12 files).
widen = the one extra file with end stamp H+1:05 that a slice ending at hour H takes (see the dry-run lines).
A slice H1-H2 takes buckets H1..H2 plus the widen file of H2; sizes in MB (MiB, as the tool prints them).
